-- Full ship construction in one program.
-- x -3..3 (7 wide), z -6..6 (13 long), bow north z=-6, stern/entrance z=+6
-- floor/keel y=-61, interior air y=-60,-59,-58, deck y=-57

local design = {}

-- 1. Solid hull box (all solid first), then hollow
for x=-3,3 do
  for y=-61,-57 do
    for z=-6,6 do
      table.insert(design, {name="oak_planks", pos={x=x,y=y,z=z}})
    end
  end
end

-- 2. Hollow interior: x -2..2, y -60..-58, z -5..5  -> air (passage)
for x=-2,2 do
  for y=-60,-58 do
    for z=-5,5 do
      table.insert(design, {name="air", pos={x=x,y=y,z=z}})
    end
  end
end

-- 3. Entrance: south wall z=+6, doorway x=0,1, y=-60..-58 -> air
for x=0,1 do
  for y=-60,-58 do
    table.insert(design, {name="air", pos={x=x,y=6,z=6,y2=y}})
  end
end

numen.build.place(design)
print("hull done, cells:", #design)

-- Stern entry: cut opening in south wall (z=6), x=-1..1, y=-60..-59 (2 high)
-- Set those cells to air.
local entry = {}
for x=-1,1 do
  for y=-60,-59 do
    entry[#entry+1] = {name="minecraft:air", pos={x=x,y=y,z=6}}
  end
end
local r = numen.build.place(entry)
print("entry placed", r.placed, "cleared", r.cleared, "unplaced", #r.unplaced)
for _,u in ipairs(r.unplaced) do print("  ", u.kind, u.says) end

-- Interior walls are at x=-3 and x=3, spanning z=-6..6, wall height y=-60..-58 (3 tall, floow at -61).

  for _,z in ipairs({-3,0,3}) do
    sides[#sides+1] = {name="minecraft:glass_pane", pos={x=x,y=-59,z=z}}

end
